title: Brickonomy Instagram carousel payload
description: One LEGO set's market snapshot, rendered into a 4:5 (1080x1350) Instagram carousel. All money values are USD.

theme.description: Optional theme line shown under the name.

image_url.description: http(s) URL, file:// URL, or a local path. Omit to use BrickLink's catalog image (img.bricklink.com/ItemImage/SN/0/<number>-1.png). A generated placeholder is drawn if the picture cannot be fetched.

currency.description: Currency of every money field in this payload (pricing, market.previous_new_value, minifigs[].used_price). Slides always show USD.

fx_rate.description: Units of `currency` per 1 USD (e.g. 3.02 for ILS). Required for accurate conversion when currency is not USD; a built-in fallback is used otherwise.

msrp.description: Retail price, in `currency`. Displayed in USD rounded to the nearest $5.

new_value.description: Current sealed/new market value, in `currency`. Displayed in USD rounded to the nearest $5.

used_value.description: Current used/complete market value, in `currency`. Displayed in USD rounded to the nearest $5.

minifigs_used_total.description: Combined used value of every minifigure (quantity-weighted), in `currency`. Computed from `minifigs` when omitted.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 date or datetime ("2026-09-08" or "2026-09-08T06:00:00Z"). Rendered as "Prices valid as of Sep 8, 2026".

previous_new_value.description: Last month's new value, in `pricing.currency`. Used to derive `trend` when `trend` is omitted.

change_pct.description: Signed percent change vs last month, e.g. 4.1 or -2.5.

change_usd.description: Signed USD change vs last month.

minifigs.description: Rendered 4 per slide in the order given (or by value with --sort value).

name.description: Character name. Long BrickLink variant descriptions are fine; the card clamps to two lines.

used_price.description: Used unit price, in `pricing.currency`. Displayed in USD rounded to the nearest $1.

quantity.description: How many of this figure the set contains (shows a x4 badge and weights the total).

image_url.description: http(s) URL, file:// URL or local path. Omit to use BrickLink's catalog image (img.bricklink.com/ItemImage/MN/0/<code>.png). Placeholder on failure.

site_name.description: Account name shown in the post header next to the avatar.

url.description: Optional website line under the handle in the footer.

handle.description: Instagram handle shown in the footer watermark.

avatar.description: Profile picture shown in the story ring: a path relative to carousel/ (bundled asset), relative to the payload, or a URL. Square images work best.

accent.description: Solid accent colour (Instagram pink by default).

gradient.description: CSS gradient used for the progress bar, story rings, highlight card and gradient text. Defaults to the Instagram brand gradient.

cta.default: Full price history on the site

hook.description: Copy for the bold lead-in slide shown before the hero (only rendered by themes that provide a hook.html; poster has one, currently). Any field left out is auto-generated from the pricing data.

kicker.description: Small badge above the image, e.g. "Retirement watch". Defaults to "Price check".

headline.description: The big bold hook line, e.g. "When will the Avengers Tower retire?". Defaults to a short stat line like "+1% since 2023".

sub.description: Small line under the headline. Defaults to "Swipe for the full breakdown".

forecast.description: Optional forward-looking price prediction, rendered as an extra closing slide (only by themes with a forecast.html; poster has one). Omit this field entirely to skip the slide -- unlike hook, there's no auto-generated fallback for a number this speculative.

year.description: Year the predicted value is for.

retire_note.description: Short line about expected retirement, e.g. "Still active -- expected to stay in stores until 2028".

caption.description: Optional longer analysis paragraph. When set, it becomes the main content of the slide (a text-heavy closer) instead of the year/value stat card. Blank lines split it into separate paragraphs.

highlight_label.description: Optional small lead-in line above the highlight value, e.g. "Predicted price right after retirement:".

highlight_value.description: Optional short bold takeaway shown big under the caption, e.g. "1.2x more!". Requires highlight_label to make sense, but either can be set alone.
